clauses.name: hospitalization_coverage
clauses.explanation: The policy covers primary in-patient hospitalization under Section 3.1 and also includes domiciliary hospitalization for periods exceeding three days when treatment is at home due to inability to move or lack of hospital room.
clauses.evidence: We will cover, on a reimbursement basis, medical treatment for a period exceeding three days for such an illness/disease/injury which in the normal course would require care and treatment at a hospital but is actually taken while confined at home under any of the following circumstances: i. The condition of the patient is such that he/she is not in a condition to be moved to a hospital or ii. The patient takes treatment at home on account of non-availability of room in a hospital.

clauses.name: pre_existing_disease_waiting_period
clauses.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 48 months from the first policy inception, with reduced periods for continuous coverage and fresh exclusion for increased sum insured.
clauses.evidence: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 48 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with us.

clauses.name: disease_sub_limits
clauses.explanation: The policy specifies sub-limits for certain modern treatment methods, such as up to 70% of Sum Insured for Deep Brain Stimulation and up to 20% for Balloon Sinuplasty, with maximum monetary caps.
clauses.evidence: Up to 70% of Sum Insured per policy period for claims involving Deep Brain Stimulation

clauses.name: exclusions
clauses.explanation: Exclusions include treatment for a list of diseases for domiciliary hospitalization, a 48‑month waiting period for pre-existing diseases, a 24‑ or 48‑month waiting period for specific diseases/procedures, and a 30‑day first‑policy waiting period.
clauses.evidence: 4.2 Specific Disease/ Procedure Waiting Period (Code- Excl02): i. Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments as per Table A and Table B below, shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months and 48 months respectively of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with us.
